rules.sentence: Tricuspid stenosis is a rare valvular abnormality characterized by tricuspid valve narrowing.
Tricuspid stenosis is the narrowing of the tricuspid orifice that obstructs blood flow from the right atrium to the right ventricle.
The cause of tricuspid stenosis can be broadly classified into 3 categories: acquired, congenital, and iatrogenic.[2]
The right atrium hypertrophies and distends, and sequelae of right heart disease-induced heart failure develop but without right ventricular dysfunction.
